title: The Markov Marginal Problem for Density Operators
summary: We study when local reduced density operators, viewed as quantum marginals, can be assembled into a global quantum state with a prescribed Markov structure. The starting point is a canonical logarithmic construction $T(\mathcal R)$, the noncommutative analogue of the junction-tree formula for decomposable graphical models. Unlike in the classical case, this formal construction may fail: noncommutativity can prevent it from being a normalized state with the prescribed marginals.
